name: Vidblysk Burshtynu
source:
Step into a tale woven with intrigue, mystery, and hidden motives. Journey to the secluded village of Brightmere, lost in a sea of forest and fog. Together with seasoned Detective Redbreast, you must unravel the truth behind the sudden death of a local resident. Armed with a supernatural ability to slow time using an old camera, you'll uncover details invisible to the naked eye. One fateful night, one real culprit, and five possible endings await!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562420/Reflections_in_Amber/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
走进一个充满阴谋、神秘和隐藏动机的故事。前往隐秘的布莱米尔村庄，迷失在森林和雾海中。你必须与经验丰富的雷德布雷斯特侦探一起，揭开当地居民突然死亡背后的真相。凭借使用旧相机放慢时间的超自然能力，你将发现肉眼看不见的细节。一个决定命运的夜晚，一个真正的罪魁祸首，以及五种可能的结局正在等待着！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562420/Reflections_in_Amber/]Steam[/url]]
